templateVersions.content:
You are generating a structured handoff note for a TableTopia human support agent who is about to pick up an escalated chat session from Aria, the AI assistant.
Produce output in EXACTLY this format — no prose, no preamble, no extra sections:
ESCALATION SUMMARY ==================== {{Input.CaseContext}}
ISSUE ----- [Write 2-3 sentences: what the diner needed, what Aria attempted, and why it could not be resolved automatically. Use the transcript below. Write in third person.]
RESOLUTIONS OFFERED BY ARIA ---------------------------- [List each action Aria attempted as a bullet: "- [action] — [outcome]". If none, write "- None"]
ESCALATION REASON ----------------- {{Input.IssueClassification}} — [one-line plain-language description of why the diner was transferred]
----
Transcript: {{Input.Transcript}}
